patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks who heads the National Crisis Management Committee (Cabinet Secretary) and the current AG name; also 'Cabinet' word in Art. 352 (44th Amdt) and collective responsibility as the defining parliamentary feature.
Other PSCs/UPSC: Council of Ministers collectively responsible only to Lok Sabha; government defeat in Rajya Sabha has no consequence; AG can speak and sit on committees but not vote (Art. 88).
Cabinet Secretariat functions (agenda, assistance to committees, not fund allocation) recur in statement form.
App adds many cabinet-committee chair/2019-committee items and opinion-style 'criticism' questions not seen in PYQs.
